title: Get your fiscal code
whatHappens: Your *codice fiscale* is Italy's tax ID number, issued by the Agenzia delle Entrate (Revenue Agency). You need it for almost everything that follows: signing a lease, opening a bank account, even buying a SIM card in some cases.
whoDecides: The Agenzia delle Entrate issues it — usually the same day, in person.
timing: Do this as early as possible after arrival; other steps depend on it.
whatKimereDoes: We book your appointment and come with you, so you leave with your fiscal code in hand on day one.
